crossRefs.note: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.

translations.web: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.
translations.bsb: and they loaded the grain on their donkeys and departed.
translations.kjv: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed
translations.asv: And they laded their asses with their grain, and departed thence.
